selection_timing: freeze IDs only after repaired catalog exists

MP.strata: 6 per each of 10 closed profile_field_type values when naturally available; shortfall reported, never synthetically filled
MP.acceptance_criterion: zero critical wrong-owner/future/prior-only facts and human macro precision >=0.90; report Wilson intervals and every subtype
MP.review: two blind humans on all items; adjudicate disagreements; optional LLM is annotation aid only

MS.strata: continuity_type event/state/change x observed status x owner coverage; natural shortfall reported
MS.acceptance_criterion: zero current/future/profile leakage and human macro precision >=0.90 across event/state/change
MS.review: two blind humans on all items; adjudicate disagreements; optional LLM is annotation aid only

ME.planned_N: all repaired accepted ME when <=120; otherwise stratified 120 plus every rare outcome type
ME.strata: outcome type x single-turn/multi-turn lineage x linked/unlinked prior; all critical edge cases
ME.acceptance_criterion: zero third-party/future/purpose/prediction/same-predicate critical errors and human precision >=0.90
ME.review: two blind humans on all selected ME because current natural inventory is sparse; optional LLM cannot cast final vote

estimated_cost.human_reviews: MP120 + MS144 + ME up to 240 individual blind reviews, before adjudication
